name: winds
about: The Greek gods of the winds (the Anemoi): the four chief winds and the lesser winds

names.name: Boreas
names.note: North wind: the cold air of winter

names.name: Zephyrus
names.note: West wind: light breezes of spring and early summer

names.name: Notus
names.note: South wind: the storms of late summer and autumn

names.name: Eurus
names.note: Southeast wind: a storm wind that tosses ships

names.name: Kaikias
names.note: Northeast wind: shown with a shield full of hail

names.name: Apeliotes
names.note: Southeast wind: rain that helps the farmers

names.name: Skiron
names.note: Northwest wind: the start of winter

names.name: Lips
names.note: Southwest wind: shown with the stern of a ship

names.name: Argestes
names.note: Northwest wind: a wind that clears the sky

names.name: Iapyx
names.note: Northwest wind, near the direction of Skiron
